generalization_requirements: No world-specific prompt hints, hidden law templates, reference coefficients or world-index branches.
Agent and SR access current-session public observations only. All development truths and synthetic generator formulas stay in evaluator/diagnostic artifacts.
Retain every complete batch and negative result; no assembling six best worlds from different attempts.
Explicitly distinguish polynomial/periodic/log-response helper priors from pure PySR discoveries. Absence of literal laws does not prove absence of development-set overfitting.
Freeze new versions before evaluation on additional structures, random coefficients and rotated coordinates; tool-only transfer checks do not certify Agent performance on unknown nine worlds.
next_priorities: Generic experimental-design diagnostics for unvaried and perfectly confounded public attributes; never prescribe a physical relationship.
Deliver validation-to-training discrepancies and observed counterexamples at validation time; do not alter user submission OR gate or silently select a formula.
Evaluate new generic diagnostics with synthetic data and frozen full-Agent batches, without per-world retries.
